info.name: Delivez — Rider: live on production (Food, Pharmacy, Grocery)
info.description:
Only the rider APIs that are **deployed on https://dispatch.delivez.com today** (checked 2026-11-28), for the finished Delivez Now modules:
- **Food Delivery** (shops with vertical `EAT`, rider module `food`)
- **Pharmacy** and **Grocery Delivery** (vertical `PHARMACY` / `GROCERY`, rider module `quickCommerce`)

Sign-up is in *Delivez — Driver (Rider) Registration*. The rider must be **approved** for the module.

1. Production environment → set `riderPhone` → *1. Sign-in* (SMS code into `otpCode`).
2. *2. Online & GPS* → Go online, GPS ping.
3. Open the module folder: Current offer → Accept → steps. At the shop show `handover.code`; the **shop** enters it (= picked up). At the door put the customer's code in `deliveryCode`.

Coming with the next server update (in *Delivez — Rider App (work)*): item check, delivery photos, contactless / safe drop, Food packaging check and "food is late", UPI collection, history, earnings, attendance, company vehicles.

⚠ Production: real SMS, real orders. Use a test rider.

exec: // Test servers only: the code is in the reply. On production it comes by SMS: put it in otpCode.

request.description: `next = HOME` means approved: the work screens below are open.
Access tokens last 15 min. Returns a new pair; the old refresh token stops working.

item.name: 2. Online & GPS
item.description: Send a GPS ping every `gpsEverySeconds` (≈30 s) while online; without pings you stop getting jobs.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); console.log('online:', j.online, '· not receiving jobs because:', j.notReceivingJobsBecause, '· cash in hand:', j.cash && j.cash.inHandToday);
const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.offer) { pm.collectionVariables.set('offerId', j.offer.id); console.log('offer', j.offer.id, j.offer.secondsLeft + 's left'); }

item.name: 3. Food Delivery
item.description: Restaurants (`vertical: "EAT"`). If you arrive before the food is ready the task shows `WAITING_AT_PICKUP`; wait for the counter.

exec: const o = pm.response.json().offer; if (o) { pm.collectionVariables.set('offerId', o.id); console.log(o.vertical, o.pickup.name, '→', o.drop.area, '·', o.secondsLeft + 's left'); } else console.log('no offer right now');
if (t && t.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('taskId', t.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('taskLines', JSON.stringify((t.items || []).filter((i) => !i.outOfStock).map((i) => i.lineId))); }
if (t && t.next) console.log('next steps allowed:', t.next.join(', '));
